warwatch.caption: Shortwave and military aircraft reports. Tap the thumbnail for the source account.

entries.headline: EAM header reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel posted the header code K774XT in its HFGCS monitoring feed. The code alone does not reveal the message’s purpose.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports. Tap the thumbnail for the source account.

entries.headline: P-8 reported on ground in Florida
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a U.S.-registered military P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida. The alert describes its tracked status; it does not establish a mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure near Port Hueneme
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a U.S.-registered military P-8 off the ground near Port Hueneme, California. Its destination and tasking were not confirmed in the alert.

entries.headline: P-3 departure near Port Hueneme
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a U.S. military P-3 off the ground near Port Hueneme, California. The tracked departure does not by itself show where it was headed.

entries.headline: Portuguese P-3 departs Beja
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a Portuguese-registered military P-3 Orion off the ground at Beja, Portugal. The post identifies the aircraft and departure, without confirming its mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure near Saundatti
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported an Indian-registered military P-8 off the ground near Saundatti, India. The alert identifies a tracked departure, without confirming its mission or destination.

entries.headline: E3TF departure near Asan
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported an E3TF aircraft off the ground near Asan, South Korea. The alert records the tracked departure without confirming its destination or mission.
